journeys.name: Plans: job card, plan, asset schedule, daily status and what is due
journeys.objective: Preventive work is described once as a job card, planned per asset, and the work that falls due is opened.
journeys.userRole: Maintenance planner (test persona; only admin was available)
journeys.preconditions: User holds the maintenance right. One branch is chosen in the header.
journeys.steps:
1. Opens Maintenance and clicks Plans in the menu
2. Clicks "Job card"
3. Types the code and the name of the job card and clicks "Save"
4. Types the asset in "Code / asset", the frequency in "Name / end" and the job card in "Job card / budget head", chooses "Plan" and clicks "Save"
5. Types the asset, the job card and the date, chooses "Asset schedule" and clicks "Save"
6. Types the asset and the date, chooses "Daily status" and clicks "Save"
7. Chooses "Open due" and clicks "Save"
journeys.expectedOutcome: A plan and a schedule need a job card.
journeys.observedOutcome: 2026-10-13: /id/maintenance/plans opened (HTTP 200, title "Plans"). The steps were not executed: they change data. 2026-10-13: "Job card" on /maintenance/plans opened the dialog "Plans"; fields: "Code / asset", "Name / end", "Job card / budget head", "Date", "Action"; buttons: Close, Save. Nothing was saved.
journeys.failureScenarios: No job card; no asset; nothing due (test case below).
journeys.validationNotes: Written in the application pass of 2026-10-13 from the screen code and the English message texts, because no earlier journey mentions this action. Not executed; texts are the English ones, the session of the pass was English. In the pass of 2026-10-13 2 of 7 steps were confirmed read-only against the live screen or dialog.
journeys.requiredTestData: Job card "X-JC-AC" "X Servis AC uji"; asset "X-AST-AC1"; frequency daily; date today

journeys.name: Breakdown to invoice: work order, budget, spare parts and completion
journeys.objective: A broken asset is reported, repaired on an approved work order with spare parts from the store, and the vendor's invoice reaches Finance.
journeys.userRole: Ward nurse, Maintenance officer, Budget officer, Accountant (test persona; only admin was available)
journeys.preconditions: User holds the maintenance right. One branch is chosen in the header. A budget head with a balance (20-budget.xlsx). A spare part in stock in a store (07-inventory.xlsx). A go-ahead to hold budget, take stock and create a Finance voucher on the test site.
journeys.steps:
1. Opens Maintenance and clicks Work in the menu
2. Clicks "Breakdown"
3. Types the number and the asset, clicks "Next" and clicks "Save" with the action "Breakdown"
4. Opens the dialog, types the order number, external in "Name / end", the vendor and the budget head, clicks "Next", pastes the id of the breakdown into "Document", types the amount, chooses "Work order" and clicks "Save"
5. Pastes the id of the order into "Document" and saves "Send order", then "Approve order"
6. Types the spare in "Job card / budget head", the store, the batch and the quantity, pastes the order id, chooses "Spare" and clicks "Save"
7. Types what was done in "Note / vendor", pastes the order id and saves "Complete"
8. Types 450000 in "Amount", pastes the order id and saves "Invoice"
journeys.expectedOutcome: States of an order: draft, sent, approved, completed. A spare needs an approved order; an invoice needs a completed one.
journeys.observedOutcome: 2026-10-13: /id/maintenance/work opened (HTTP 200, title "Work"). The steps were not executed: they change data. 2026-10-13: "Breakdown" on /maintenance/work opened the dialog "Work"; fields: "Number", "Code / asset", "Name / end", "Note / vendor", "Job card / budget head"; buttons: Close, Back, Next. Nothing was saved.
journeys.failureScenarios: An order without a breakdown; an external order without a vendor; no budget; no stock (test cases below).
journeys.validationNotes: Written in the application pass of 2026-10-13 from the screen code and the English message texts, because no earlier journey mentions this action. Not executed; texts are the English ones, the session of the pass was English. In the pass of 2026-10-13 2 of 8 steps were confirmed read-only against the live screen or dialog.
journeys.requiredTestData: Breakdown "X-BD-001" for the asset "X-AST-AC1"; work order "X-WO-001", external, vendor "X Teknisi uji", budget head, amount 500000; spare "X-FREON" from "X Gudang IPSRS", batch, quantity 1; invoice 450000

journeys.name: AMC: indent, contract, schedule and instalment
journeys.objective: A yearly maintenance contract for an asset is asked for, agreed with a vendor, scheduled, and paid in instalments through Finance.
journeys.userRole: Maintenance officer, Accountant (test persona; only admin was available)
journeys.preconditions: User holds the maintenance right. One branch is chosen in the header. A job card. A go-ahead to create a Finance voucher on the test site.
journeys.steps:
1. Opens Maintenance and clicks AMC in the menu
2. Clicks "AMC indent"
3. Types the number and the asset, clicks "Next", types the amount and clicks "Save"
4. Pastes the id of the indent into "Document" and saves "Send indent", then "Approve indent"
5. Types the contract number, the asset, the end date in "Name / end" and the vendor, clicks "Next", pastes the id of the approved indent, types the start in "Date", chooses "Contract" and clicks "Save"
6. Pastes the id of the contract and saves "Send contract", then "Approve contract"
7. Types the job card in "Job card / budget head" and a date, pastes the contract id and saves "AMC schedule"
8. Types 30000000 in "Amount", pastes the contract id and saves "Instalment"
journeys.expectedOutcome: States of indent and contract: draft, sent, approved. A contract needs an approved indent; an instalment an approved contract.
journeys.observedOutcome: 2026-10-13: /id/maintenance/amc opened (HTTP 200, title "AMC"). The steps were not executed: they change data. 2026-10-13: "AMC indent" on /maintenance/amc opened the dialog "AMC"; fields: "Number", "Code / asset", "Name / end", "Note / vendor"; buttons: Close, Back, Next. Nothing was saved.
journeys.failureScenarios: A contract without an indent; dates in the wrong order; instalments above the contract (test case below).

Not executed; texts are the English ones, the session of the pass was English. In the pass of 2026-10-13 2 of 8 steps were confirmed read-only against the live screen or dialog.
